svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — The board
svg.desc: A true circle, 330.228 mm across, double engraved ring at the water's edge. Rim squares carry a curved current arrow that follows the ring. Units: mm. 20 mm squares, 3 mm material. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
